commits.subject: Return focus to where it was when the zoom view closes

verification.notes: Criterion 2 failed on unchanged code at both 1440x900 and 390x844: before=이동할 쪽 번호 (page input), during=✕ 닫기, after=크게 보기, for Escape and ✕. Same for TOC/next buttons (criterion 3).

Both viewports, Escape and ✕: c1 크게 button -> 크게 보기; c2 page input + dblclick -> 이동할 쪽 번호; c3 목차 열기 / 다음 쪽 + dblclick -> same control; c4 body + dblclick -> 크게 보기; c5 remembered 이전 쪽 button disabled while open -> 크게 보기. Regression: TOC opens on 표지 link and closes to 목차 열기; ArrowRight blocked while zoomed and turns the page after close; Shift+Tab in zoom stays on ✕ 닫기. Only console errors: 404 /_vercel/insights/script.js (pre-existing).

verification.command_or_steps: cd web && npm test && npm run build

not_run_with_reasons: Tab behaviour in the zoom overlay was not compared against the unchanged build (in Chromium with native inert, Tab from ✕ goes to body); the diff does not touch onKey or the overlay markup.
